SELECT A.SEQNO SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.TERM TERM, A.PFLSH PFLSH, A.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 creditAmt, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, A.REMARK, A.HAP_CREDIT_AMT as hapCreditAmt, C.CUSTOMER_NAME as customerName, D.INSITITUTE_CODE as insitituteCode FROM CREDIT_LINES A INNER JOIN CREDIT_MST_INFO B on A.CREDIT_MST_ID=B.SEQNO and B.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE in ('01') left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO C on A.CUSTOMER_ID=C.CUSTOMER_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD D on A.CUSTOMER_ID=D.CUSTOMER_ID
A.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND A.PFLSH LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pflsh}),'%')
AND A.VDATE >= to_date(#{vdate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.VDATE <= to_date(#{mdate},'yyyy-MM-dd')

select A.creditMstId,A.creditQuoteTypeCode,A.creditQuoteTypeValue,A.upperCreditQuoteTypeCode,(case when count(B.creditQuoteTypeCode) > 0 then '02' else '01' end) as hasChildren ,null as creditAmt from (select m.seqno as creditMstId,m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE as creditQuoteTypeCode ,y.item_value as creditQuoteTypeValue, DECODE(trim(n.linked_item_code), ' ', 'root', trim(n.linked_item_code)) AS upperCreditQuoteTypeCode from CREDIT_MST_INFO m inner JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK n ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = n.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=n.dict_code left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code where M.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04' AND (m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK <> #{rank,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK is null) union ALL select m.seqno as creditMstId,m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE as creditQuoteTypeCode ,y.item_value as creditQuoteTypeValue,'root' AS upperCreditQuoteTypeCode from CREDIT_MST_INFO m left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code where M.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04' AND m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK =#{rank,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) A left join (select m.seqno as creditMstId,m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE as creditQuoteTypeCode ,y.item_value as creditQuoteTypeValue, DECODE(trim(n.linked_item_code), ' ', 'root', trim(n.linked_item_code)) AS upperCreditQuoteTypeCode from CREDIT_MST_INFO m inner JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK n ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = n.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=n.dict_code left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code where M.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04' AND (m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK <> #{rank,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK is null) union ALL select m.seqno as creditMstId,m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE as creditQuoteTypeCode ,y.item_value as creditQuoteTypeValue,'root' AS upperCreditQuoteTypeCode from CREDIT_MST_INFO m left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code where M.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04' AND m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK =#{rank,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) B on A.creditQuoteTypeCode=B.upperCreditQuoteTypeCode GROUP BY A.creditMstId,A.creditQuoteTypeCode,A.creditQuoteTypeValue,A.upperCreditQuoteTypeCode order by creditMstId asc,upperCreditQuoteTypeCode
